description: Read-only Player Surface Contract: observable truth outranks HTTP status and build identity

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Present the genuine community hub and its evidence-backed subtiles
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Lobby projection: featured entries, live presence, replay generation and community content
surfaces.minimumTruth: Non-2xx or missing required fields is unavailable, not an empty successful lobby
surfaces.permissions: Anonymous read; signed session required for mutations
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Explicit unavailable, never a success badge on missing data
surfaces.expectedErrors: 401/403 on protected actions; 5xx is a failed read, not empty
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Each subdataset requires an independent authoritative zero observation

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Show the featured human warrior and a loaded portrait
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Featured leaderboard entries and managed /api/avatar redirect bytes
surfaces.minimumTruth: For an actual featured entry img.complete and naturalWidth > 0; identity matches source record
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Verified placeholder only if genuinely no eligible contender or no portrait bytes; broken optimizer is failure
surfaces.expectedErrors: Avatar HTTP non-2xx or naturalWidth=0 is a display failure
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Prove leaderboard has zero eligible contenders before empty

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Render current real parsed battles and replay navigation
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Logical public battle archive sanitized/deduplicated from finalized replay records
surfaces.minimumTruth: If public archive total > 0, recent match response must contain at least one real identifiable match; no synthetic records
surfaces.permissions: Anonymous safe read of approved public projection; no guarded 3331 direct bypass
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Unavailable when reader errors; empty only if independently certified archive total=0
surfaces.expectedErrors: Non-2xx, malformed rows, or empty feed against archive > 0 is FAILURE
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Public battle archive total=0 on same source/generation

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Display persisted room history and enable signed human chat only when writer admitted
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Public lobby chatMessage history, restricted reaction aggregates and separately admitted lobby writer
surfaces.minimumTruth: GET HTTP 200 must reflect persisted permitted messages where present; real POST needs numeric committed ID and read-after-reload
surfaces.permissions: Public permitted history; signed actor for posts; no guest-session/reaction raw table grants
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: History unavailable (not empty) if restricted SQL denies; chat send disabled until independently admitted writer
surfaces.expectedErrors: 401 anonymous POST; 403 invalid identity; SQLSTATE 42501/HTTP 500 fails; disabled writer is HOLD, not mock success
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Independent message-table read with zero permitted records for room

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Show genuinely present players with verified links
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Bounded server presence/active sessions, not historical registered users
surfaces.minimumTruth: If live authoritative presence > 0, show matching active rows; historical signup is not presence
surfaces.permissions: Public projection only; no session secrets or private activity
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Presence unavailable when telemetry broken; zero only with independent current-presence census
surfaces.expectedErrors: Missing/invalid presence data is FAILURE, not zero active

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Provide durable searchable replay history, paging and verifiable provenance
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Approved public replay/history and Library Activity SQL projections
surfaces.minimumTruth: Count >= accepted historical floor 7151 unless explicitly reviewed legitimate deletion; provenanceComplete=true; load older advances without duplicate record IDs
surfaces.permissions: Public read-only sanitized history; deny raw/private replay metadata
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Show unavailable and preserve last certified count, never fabricated zero
surfaces.expectedErrors: 503 on unavailable projection, 401/403 on private metadata; never silent zero
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Authoritative independently accepted empty replay corpus (not currently possible under accepted baseline)

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Show clan history and allow member-scoped signed Clan messages
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: Clan membership, authorized clan_messages persistence from HD Social V2 writer
surfaces.minimumTruth: Same sender UID as signed session; numeric committed message ID, member history after reload and appropriate audience filtering
surfaces.permissions: Approved membership/audience; anon and nonmember denied for private room; no financial writes
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: No pretend send when writer not admitted; explicit unavailable
surfaces.expectedErrors: 401 anonymous; 403 nonmember/policy; 404 missing clan; 503 unavailable writer
surfaces.emptyEvidence: Independent permitted clan-message census=0 for authorized clan and viewer

surfaces.visiblePurpose: Provide private person-to-person inbox history and signed Direct sends
surfaces.authoritativeDataset: HD Social V2 direct_conversations and direct_messages with participant-filtered projection
surfaces.minimumTruth: Verified signed sender equals persisted sender UID; numeric committed ID; reciprocal recipient sees the same persisted ID after reload
surfaces.permissions: Only authorized participants may read; anonymous, self-send and unauthorized recipient denied
surfaces.fallbackBehavior: Unavailable when writer offline; never claim successful send from 200 inbox alone
surfaces.expectedErrors: 401 anon; 403 forbidden reader; 404 unknown recipient; 503 unavailable writer
